::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** July 7th [1880]  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS  UCLA: collection 100: box 95
:::

My dear [Anna](people/person_195.qmd),

You did not give the name of your friend’s story, but I conclude that it is the Days of the Bruce.[^1] I had so many at the same time that it is not easy to distinguish between them. However, the Bruce is a very nice story, and though I cannot certainly promise, I think it has a good chance.

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Perhaps ‘In the Days of Good King Robert’ by ‘Biscachio’, which appeared in *MP* (Christmas  1880) 58-64.
